message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on backing plate adapters. The components are imported unassembled, and the finished adapter would be a part of a backing pad for a hand-held power tool. Under GRI 2(a), unassembled articles are classified as the assembled article. The completed adapter is a tool holder or a part of a tool.

The likely candidates are:
- 8466.20 covers work holders. Its parts and accessories for machine tools fall under 8466.20, but for hand-held tools the heading is 8467.
- 8467.92 covers parts of pneumatic tools.
- 8467.99 covers parts of other tools. Under 8467.99.00, the full code is 8467.99.0195 or similar.
- 8466.10 covers tool holders and self-opening dieheads. Its subheading 8466.10.01 covers tool holders for the tools of heading 8467, and the statistical suffix is 8466.10.0140 or 8466.10.0160.

A backing pad holding abrasive discs on a hand-held power tool is a tool holder for the tools of 8467, rather than a part of the tool itself. In HTSUS, 8466.10.01 covers "Tool holders and self-opening dieheads", with 8466.10.0105 for those for machine tools of 8456 and 8466.10.0125 for those for 8457-8465. The remaining subheadings include 8466.10.0145 or 8466.10.0160 for those for tools of 8467. I recall 8466.10.0150 as well, though I am less certain of it. I'll go with 8466.10.0160, which I believe is the "other" category.

